questions.question: Describe the features or API routes for DataSentry AI API.
questions.answer: GET /health: Backend health check. POST /api/analyze: Validate bounded CSV uploads, perform deterministic Pandas analysis, calculate data-quality metrics and numerical statistics, identify potential anomalies, and return actual processing timings. POST /api/interpret: Optionally use the Gemini API to generate evidence-based explanations and recommendations from calculated metrics. Validate structured AI output and handle missing API keys, timeouts, and provider errors gracefully. Provide downloadable JSON analysis reports. Enforce upload limits, validate input, protect secrets, avoid permanent storage of uploaded files, and return safe, structured error responses.
